summary: Iteration 93 - P0 Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All 7 features verified working: (1) Production workflow settings default to simple mode, (2) Productivity calendar defaults to jobs only, (3) Reports nav redirects to /financials instead of logout, (4) Order detail page loads without crash after file upload, (5) Uploaded image files display visible thumbnails, (6) Tenant branding properly isolated between sessions, (7) Ticket scheduling dialog date picker is functional.

issues: File thumbnail area is small (56x56px) - image may appear tiny but is functional

critical_code_review_comments: Production workflow settings correctly default to 'simple' mode via DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_SETTINGS in production_timeline.py
Productivity.js correctly initializes itemTypes filter to ['job'] only, excluding tasks and appointments by default
App.js has proper route: <Route path='/reports' element={<Navigate to='/financials' replace />} /> - no logout behavior
PrimaryNav.js Reports nav item correctly points to path: '/financials'
OrderDetail.js properly handles file uploads with loadOrderFileThumbs() function that creates blob URLs for image thumbnails
AppContext.js properly clears tenant state on logout and re-fetches on login via useEffect watching isAuthenticated and user.tenant_id
TicketWorkflowShortcutDialog.js has proper date input with showPicker() calls and calendar button for date selection
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 93 verified P0 fixes: (1) GET /api/production-timeline/settings returns workflow_mode='simple' by default, (2) Productivity page initializes with itemTypes=['job'] filter active, (3) /reports route redirects to /financials via React Router Navigate, (4) Order detail page at /orders/{id} loads without crash, Files tab shows uploaded files, (5) Image file thumbnails display via blob URLs from /api/orders/{id}/files/{file_id}/content endpoint, (6) Tenant branding fetched fresh on login via AppContext useEffect, (7) Ticket schedule dialog opens with date input and calendar button - date picker works with user gesture.
